# Ministry of Testing

> > A global community and learning platform dedicated to advancing software testing through education, events, and collaboration.

Ministry of Testing provides testing professionals with resources including TestBash conferences, the Dojo learning platform, community forums, and comprehensive guides for contributors and speakers. The organization fosters a collaborative testing community while offering certification programs and professional development opportunities.

## Key Topics

- TestBash conferences
- Dojo learning platform
- Software testing education
- Testing community
- Contributor guidelines
- Writing and publishing policies
- Certification programs
- Speaking opportunities
- Community-driven content
- Testing best practices
- Professional development
- Team culture and values

## Support & Help Resources

- [Ministry of Testing Guide](https://help.ministryoftesting.com/): Support hub for Ministry of Testing site, TestBash, Dojo & community guides

## Community & Culture

- [Life at The Ministry of Testing](https://life.ministryoftesting.com/): Company blog featuring stories from Ministry of Testing team members
